value.rationale: The exact structure of every conditional online version space is captured by two simple canonical states; negative-only histories are compressed to integer partitions instead of arbitrary sets of interval hypotheses. This supplies an exact all-domain online rank recurrence and decision procedure for a canonical VC-two class, with an infinite sharp cardinality-bound family and the asymptotically maximal two-logarithm online separation. This is a structural characterization, not a routine fixed-parameter substitution or an isolated table increment.
